Mosaic
Place the pieces. Find the pattern. Fill the grid.
PuzzleDailyVisualGaming
🍎 Download on App Store▶ Google Play — Coming Soon
About
A bright, colorful puzzle game where you drag pieces of 3 to 5 blocks onto the board to rebuild a hidden picture. Pieces can overlap as long as their blocks match — a clash shows a red ✕. 300 levels in five stages that grow from 4×4 to 6×6, and every level starts with one piece already locked in place. Eight block colors each with its own symbol, four boosters, a free daily gift, and gems to spend in the Shop on boosters and block skins (Fruit, Space, Candy, and Sports). No ads, no in-app purchases, no account, and it plays fully offline.
Highlights
Colorblind friendlyEvery block color has its own symbol, plus a bolder Colorblind Mode.
Gems & ShopEarn gems by solving levels and spinning the daily gift, then unlock boosters and fun block skins.
300 levelsFive stages from 4×4 to 6×6; replay any level from the level menu.
No ads, no trackingNo account needed, and it plays fully offline.
